summary: New Oriental Education & Technology Group filed a Form  ⁠6-K furnishing a Hong Kong Stock Exchange  ⁠announcement dated October 8, 2026 regarding notice of its annual general meeting and record date. The AGM is scheduled for 5  ⁠p.m. Beijing/Hong Kong time on November 13, 2026 in Beijing, with a  ⁠record date of close of business October 23, 2026. No resolutions are proposed as of the notice date. This is a  ⁠routine meeting notice, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor apply.
